script.title: लोणारचं विवर कुणी खोदलं? वीस लाख टनांच्या उल्केने
sentences: बुलढाण्यातल्या एका विवराच्या मातीत चंद्रावरच्या दगडांसारखी खनिजं सापडली आहेत.
२०१९ मध्ये आयआयटी बॉम्बेच्या अभ्यासात हे समोर आलं, आणि ते विवर म्हणजे आपलं लोणार.
हे विवर अठराशे मीटर रुंद आणि दीडशे मीटर खोल आहे, आणि त्याच्या तळाशी खाऱ्या पाण्याचं सरोवर आहे.
आधी असं मानलं जायचं की हा एखाद्या ज्वालामुखीचा खड्डा असेल.
आजूबाजूचा सगळा खडकही लाव्हापासून बनलेला दख्खनचा बेसाल्टच आहे.
पण विवराच्या तळाखालून काढलेल्या नमुन्यांत भयंकर धक्क्याच्या खुणा सापडल्या.
खरं उत्तर आकाशातून आलं होतं, वीस लाख टनांची एक उल्का प्रचंड वेगाने इथे आदळली होती.
पूर्णपणे बेसाल्टमध्ये तयार झालेलं असं उल्का-विवर जगात हे एकच आहे.
चंद्रावरचे दगड आणायला अपोलो मोहिमा लागल्या, त्यांच्यासारखी खनिजं बुलढाण्यात आधीच पडून होती.
scenes: Extreme close-up of an Indian scientist's astonished face looking at glittering grey soil grains under a lab microscope light, eyes wide with discovery, cool blue lab light.
Scientists in white coats examining soil samples at a lab bench, a photograph of the round Lonar crater lake on the wall, excited faces, bright lab light, medium shot.
Aerial view of the huge round Lonar crater in Maharashtra, a green-blue saline lake at its bottom, forested rim, golden morning light, wide shot.
A 1950s geologist in khaki with a hat standing on the rim of the Lonar crater, frowning thoughtfully at the basin below, sketching volcano shapes in a notebook, afternoon light, medium shot.
Black Deccan basalt rock layers in a cliff near Lonar, a geologist tapping the rock with a hammer, ancient lava flows visible, warm afternoon light, close medium shot.
Researchers pulling a long cylindrical drill core sample from beneath the crater floor, examining fractured shocked rock, curious faces, overcast light, medium shot.
A blazing meteorite streaking through the sky and slamming into dark basalt plains of ancient India, a giant fireball and shockwave, dramatic cinematic wide shot.
The perfectly round Lonar crater in dark basalt at sunset, its lake glowing orange, birds flying overhead, majestic wide aerial shot.
A lunar landscape blending into the Lonar crater, the Moon glowing above the crater lake at night, mysterious and awe-inspiring mood, wide shot.
script.description:
बुलढाण्यातलं लोणार सरोवर एका उल्केच्या धडकेने बनलं.
जगात असं विवर हे एकच.
claims_en: A 2019 study by IIT Bombay found minerals in soil samples from the Lonar crater similar to those in lunar rocks brought to Earth by the Apollo missions
Lonar crater is in Buldhana district, Maharashtra
The crater is 1.8 km (1800 m) in diameter and 150 m deep
The crater holds a saline lake
The lake was initially thought to be of volcanic origin
The surrounding rock is Deccan basalt formed from lava flows (Deccan Traps)
Drill cores beneath the crater floor yielded evidence of shock metamorphism from the impact
The crater was formed by the hypervelocity impact of a two million tonne meteorite
Lonar is the only terrestrial impact crater in the world formed entirely within basalt
